intro: Membership is handled on Campus Labs, MacEwan's official club portal. Here's exactly what to do, so you're not left guessing once you get there.

steps.title: Open MULC on Campus Labs
steps.body: Use the button on this page. It goes straight to our club page.

steps.title: Sign in with your MacEwan account
steps.body: The same login you use for myMacEwan and Moodle.

steps.title: Press "Join" and answer the short form
steps.body: [Program, year, and what you're hoping to get from MULC.]

steps.title: Watch for your welcome email
steps.body: An exec approves new members within [3 days]. You'll then get event invites and RSVP links.

requirements: A MacEwan student taking at least one course this term (full-time, part-time or distance)
Request to join on Campus Labs and get approved by an exec
No law or pre-law background needed
requirementsNote: Students from other schools can join events when invited by the execs.
